name: Walcert Agent
description: Walcert Agent is an agent developed by Global Score Agent that issues A-F wallet maturity certificates on Celo through real-time analysis (hot-analysis): Origins (source of funds), Activity (recent activity and wash trading), Multi-Chain (multi-network presence, longevity and intensity) and Portfolio (composition and concentration). Scoring runs on Supabase Edge Functions using data from Alchemy, GoldRush and Zerion. Server-to-server consumption via HTTP JSON. x402 payments are live: each certificate costs 0.05 USDC on Celo mainnet, settled gasless (EIP-3009) via the x402.celo.org facilitator. A free preview endpoint returns only the A-F grade. Public hybrid verification is available at POST /v1/verify (lookup by on-chain tx_hash + Celo NewFeedback + EIP-712; no payment).

services.name: walcert-origins
services.description: Certifies the source of funds (CEX, mixers, OFAC, bridges) and mixing risk. Requires x402 payment (0.05 USDC on Celo).

services.name: walcert-activity
services.description: Certifies recent activity, counterparties and detection of wash trading / circular patterns. Requires x402 payment (0.05 USDC on Celo).

services.name: walcert-multichain
services.description: Certifies multi-chain presence, consistency and longevity (includes Celo). Requires x402 payment (0.05 USDC on Celo).

services.name: walcert-portfolio
services.description: Certifies portfolio composition, liquidity and concentration (HHI), filtering spam/dust. Requires x402 payment (0.05 USDC on Celo).

services.name: walcert-preview
services.description: Free preview: returns only the A-F grade (no metrics/signature, no payment). Available for origins and activity under /v1/preview/{type}. multichain and portfolio require the paid certificate endpoint.

services.name: walcert-verify
services.description: Public hybrid verification by on-chain tx_hash: database lookup + Celo NewFeedback confirmation + EIP-712 signature check. No payment. Body: {"tx_hash":"0x..."}.
